title: Novelty spec
description: What the behavioural novelty analyzer learns (ADR-0036 decision 2; docs/novelty.md): profiles, each one lake table, an entity column, one or more value columns (dotted paths validated against the table's schema), optional equality filters and the scoring parameters. The rules a schema cannot state (the table exists, every path is a scalar column of it, ids are unique, min_history_days <= learn_days) are in homelabnext.novelty.spec.

id.description: The profile's id, unique in the spec; written into every finding's profile column.

description.description: The question the profile asks, in words.

table.description: The lake table read (a name load_schemas knows; checked by homelabnext.novelty.spec).

entity_kind.description: The shared entity namespace of the entity column (ADR-0036 decision 7), written into every finding's entity_kind so corroborate matches entities across sources.

entity.description: The column path whose value is the entity (a top-level column or a dotted path into a struct, such as src_endpoint.ip): a scalar column that is not a timestamp.

values.description: The column paths whose values the entity is learned to have (scalar, not timestamp).

where.description: Equality filters on scalar, non-timestamp column paths, bound as parameters; each value must have its column's type.

time_column.description: The timestamp column windows are taken on (default time).

learn_days.description: The UTC days of history before the scoring window that are learned from.

half_life_days.description: The age in days at which a day's count weighs half.

score_hours.description: The scoring window [as_of - score_hours, as_of), never learned from in the same run.

min_support.description: Decayed support at or above which a value is normal for its entity.

entity_min_samples.description: Decayed entity total at which confidence reaches 1.

max_values_per_entity.description: Distinct learned values above which an entity is reported once as high-cardinality and not scored.

emit_at.description: The score at or above which a pair is a finding.

max_findings.description: The most rows the profile emits per run; the number dropped is reported.

min_history_days.description: Days of history the table must hold in the learning window before the profile scores (default learn_days; at most learn_days); until then the profile is warming and emits nothing.
